meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Annual spatial statements, including RRBs, from March 2023
meta.coverage: Bank offices by the size of their deposits or credit, by bank group and population group (statements 6A and 6B), every March since 2023, including regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1432 (data provider DP5), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published.
